title: Powershell: Get Strings
desc: Finds all readable strings inside of a binary file, useful for analyzing executables

title: Powershell: Strip Streams
desc: Finds all alternative data streams and optionally removes them from the file, usefully for avoiding AV issues when running executables from the internet

title: Powershell: Encrypt/Decrypt File
desc: Encrypts a file to a .encrypt file or decrypts it back using AES-256 with a password-derived key, useful for protecting sensitive files at rest
